value.justification: Mandatory actual status core, recipient lookup and notification store execution on the owned restricted LOGIN fixture; denial, SQL faults, commit ordering and data-only callback/result assertions. Native automated email mode and injected push sink prevent external delivery. No audit-projection SQL credit or general closure-lifetime proof is claimed.
requiredAssertions: actual status core rejects missing session, non-staff and foreign staff scope before mutation; committed status precedes fresh notification transactions
restricted LOGIN recipient lookup returns only same-tenant user; foreign or absent user, empty email and forced lookup SQL failure produce no send; schema rejects null email
actual notification store checks tenant and user, inserts only tenant-owned notification, denies foreign recipient and rolls back forced insert failure
public result and notification callback carry only expected data; tenant context is clear after settlement; verified-recipient email and push preserve best-effort behavior without external delivery
